findings.title: Action IDs non-sequential when unknown blockers are skipped
findings.body: compile_action_plan() used enumerate(blockers) for ID generation, producing gapped IDs (action-0001, action-0003) when an unknown blocker appeared between known ones. Fixed by using a separate action_num counter that only increments on recognized blockers. Added test_ids_stay_sequential_when_unknown_blocker_between_known.

findings.title: compile() shadows Python built-in
findings.body: Public function named compile shadowed Python's built-in. Renamed to compile_action_plan. Tests import as alias for readability.

findings.title: Silent coercion to placeholder values hides malformed inputs
findings.body: pr_number and repo silently defaulted to 0/''. Added explicit KeyError for missing required keys (pr_number, repo, readiness). Three validation tests added.

findings.title: Unknown blocker skip behavior undocumented
findings.body: Added inline comment explaining forward-compat rationale. Added test_unknown_blocker_is_silently_skipped.

findings.title: Empty string item IDs ambiguous normalization
findings.body: _item_id helper now returns None directly for falsy IDs. test_empty_string_item_id_collapses_to_none added.

findings.title: Static mutation test was brittle substring check
findings.body: Replaced string search with behavioral assertion: plan['mutation_performed'] is False plus type check.
